title: 🚀 Launching Perun the Trader: Local Crypto Automation, Now Official with WEEX (and 100% Free)
author: azagor
selftext:
​

Hey everyone,

I built \*\*Perun the Trader\*\* because I was tired of standard trading apps. Most platforms force you to upload your private API keys to their cloud servers, charge hefty monthly subscriptions, and track your data.

Perun is completely different. It’s an Android-native crypto trading platform that runs \*\*entirely on your own device\*\*. No cloud servers. No API key uploads. No monthly fees. Everything executes locally, meaning your keys never leave your phone.

It runs quietly in the background—scanning the markets, monitoring indicators, and managing your positions even when your screen is turned off.

\### What’s packed inside:

 \* \*\*Spot & Futures Support:\*\* Full control over your trading style.

 \* \*\*Complete Strategy Suite:\*\* Built-in indicators like RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Ichimoku Cloud, and EMA crossovers.

 \* \*\*Automated Grid Trading:\*\* Features built-in exit recovery to handle sudden market shifts.

 \* \*\*Advanced Risk Protection:\*\* SL/TP/DTP monitors equipped with velocity protection to guard against flash crashes.

 \* \*\*Risk-Free Paper Trading:\*\* Test, tweak, and perfect your strategies without risking a single cent.

\### Official WEEX Integration & Free Access

I’m incredibly excited to announce that Perun is now officially integrated with \*\*WEEX\*\* (you'll see them right in the exchange list in the latest app update).

Because of this official partnership, \*\*the application is now completely free to download and use.\*\*

\### 🎁 Launch Campaign: Claim a 20 USDT Futures Bonus

To celebrate getting everything hooked up, WEEX is running an exclusive welcome promo for Perun users. It’s a great way to test the integration with some house money.

Here is exactly how to grab it:

 1. \*\*Hit Register:\*\* Go to the official campaign page and click the \*\*"Register Now"\*\* button (you have to do this first to be eligible!).

 2. \*\*Connect:\*\* Link your WEEX API inside the Perun app.

 3. \*\*Trade:\*\* Execute your first Futures trade via the API.

Once that first trade hits, a \*\*20 USDT futures trial fund\*\* will be credited to your account within 24 hours (on business days). While the bonus itself covers your margin and fees, \*\*any and all profits you make from it are 100% yours to keep and withdraw.\*\*

⚠️ \*Note: WEEX has capped this for the \*\*first 150 users\*\*, so if you're planning to set it up, definitely grab it sooner rather than later.\*

 \* \*\*Campaign Period:\*\* Running right now until \*\*July 17th, 2026\*\*

 \* \*\*Google Play Promo:\*\* Live right now!

If you want to keep your keys in your own pocket and let a local bot do the heavy lifting for free, give it a shot.

comments.body: Local execution is the right call  -  most 'AI trading' tools that hold your keys on their servers are just honeypots waiting to happen. Different approach on the analysis side: trademates.co keeps the AI in the analyst seat with structured recommendations and risk class per ticker, no auto-execution, no keys. https://trademates.co  -  US equities only, not crypto or futures. Your local-first model with WEEX integration is solving a different problem than I am, curious how you handle the velocity protection logic across different exchange rate limits.
